checks: Nested fragment controls: 27 malformed variants, overlap, whole-source/AST identity, Unicode/range ancestry, global IDs, symlink/manifest confinement and actual depth boundary.
cost: Source hashing and repeated artifact/catalog/profile IO plus ordered registry/group/fragment checks; sorted membership Q log P comparisons instead of QP. Transitive ancestor traversals can repeat quadratically.
description: Validate a contract tree, inventory every visible Git Rust file and extract a finite reference table. Wave34 deepens five scoped validation models and exact-byte decode memo composition; evidence remains finite.
forward: A well-formed registry maps known source files to declared contracts; missing files remain explicit.
A successful table extraction preserves 256 distinct in-domain rows.
Groupant inventory preserves open manifests and diagnoses stale sources, missing artifacts and invalid required typed-family declarations.
Group/root manifests bind exact immediate children and every transitive registered source hash; missing manifests remain backlog.
Optional section references resolve to one exact plain H2 heading outside supported fenced blocks.
Opt-in AST artifact checks bind the declared source identity and structural byte bounds.
File sidecars may own recursive fragment trees bound to the same Rust source; validate child ownership, scoped ranges, required models and explicit parent composition.
Optional fragment syntax-node selections bind the exact enclosing byte range to a current source-bound partial projection.
inverse: Cycles, unknown/double parents, missing directions and escaping source symlinks are rejected.
Missing contracts or tables are never silently treated as verified coverage.
Fragment counts cannot increase file coverage or establish full/disjoint semantic decomposition.
limitations: Source fingerprints bind a snapshot, not semantic equivalence.
Dependencies can cross the abstraction tree; this is not a complete call graph.
Group source closure follows the declared registry tree; unregistered semantic dependencies and mathematical validity remain outside structural validation.
Section matching uses a documented narrow catalog grammar, not arbitrary rendered Markdown.
File-local child declarations organize models inside one sidecar; they are not extra source owners or a complete control/data-flow graph.
Selected syntax nodes anchor ranges but are not reparsed or semantically certified by groupant validation.
state: (IDs, single-parent tree, direct/inverse clauses, paths, SHA digests, 4^4 table rows)
